query:
Did everyone on Maple Street attend the summer street party?

Options:
A. Claudette
B. Femi
C. Jordan
D. Vera
context:
[1] (about=Femi, episodic, t6 @2025-05-26T18:02:00) Great, that's Claudette, Marcus's family, Jordan, and me confirmed. Vera, are you able to join this year?
[2] (about=Vera, episodic, t6 @2025-05-26T21:11:00) On call that weekend. Apologies.
[3] (about=Femi, episodic, t5 @2025-05-26T17:30:00) Quick question for the street, summer street party! I know Len used to organise this but since he moved I've gone ahead and booked the road closure for the last Saturday of July. Same format as before: tables out front, bring something to share. Is everyone in? Need to know numbers for the council permit.
[4] (about=Femi, episodic, t7 @2025-06-02T16:02:00) What a day. Best turnout we've had in years. Thanks all for making it work. Jordan, you were brilliant on the set-up. Claudette's sponge was the centrepiece as ever. Thanks all!
[5] (about=Jordan, episodic, t6 @2025-05-26T17:47:00) yes!! I'll come 🎉 happy to help set up in the morning if needed
[6] (about=Marcus, episodic, t6 @2025-05-26T17:44:00) We're in 🙌 kids will love it. I'll do the face painting station again.
[7] (about=Marcus, episodic, t8 @2025-06-02T16:31:00) My two are still talking about the face paint 😂 as a parent this is exactly what I want them growing up with. Same time next year Femi?
[8] (about=Vera, episodic, t8 @2025-06-02T16:48:00) glad it went well. Save me a slice next time if I'm not on call
[9] (about=Claudette, episodic, t8 @2025-06-02T16:19:00) Femi, you have done Len proud. I was quite emotional seeing the whole street out together. This is what Maple Street is for, people, not parking schemes.
[10] (about=Jordan, episodic, t8 @2025-06-02T16:24:00) so lovely 🥹 Claudette tell me about Maple Street in the 90s sometime
[11] (about=Claudette, core, t8 @2025-06-02T16:19:00) was emotional seeing the whole street out together at the summer street party, praised Femi for doing Len proud
[12] (about=Claudette, core, t8 @2025-06-02T16:19:00) in the 90s street parties were sometimes busier, people brought cassette decks and stayed until dusk
[13] (about=Femi, core, t8 @2025-06-02T16:19:00) already booked the date for next year's street party, same layout with better speakers
[14] (about=GROUP, said_by=Femi, group-interaction, t6 @2025-05-26T17:41:00) the summer street party will be residents only this year, as Claudette does not want new faces from outside the street
[15] (about=Jordan, core, t6 @2025-05-26T17:41:00) will help set up in the morning for the summer street party
[16] (about=Jordan, core, t6 @2025-05-26T17:41:00) will bring folding tables and tape for the summer street party
[17] (about=Marcus, core, t6 @2025-05-26T17:41:00) will do the face painting station again at the summer street party
[18] (about=Vera, core, t6 @2025-05-26T17:41:00) cannot join the summer street party because she is on call that weekend
[19] (about=Vera, core, t2 @2025-05-12T15:28:00) supports the parking scheme because home visits require parking on clinic days
agent_answer:
No — not everyone attended. Claudette, Femi, and Jordan were at the summer street party, but **Vera** could not attend because she was on call that weekend.

Answer: **D. Vera**
